name: search-highlight
title: Search Highlight
description: Where a search's terms are in a text, as the reader would find them (any case, full-width or not, a letter and its accents one), at the text's own places; marked in text or in a node of text, e.g. a line of coloured code, a match across its elements marked in each. Each match a soft tint (a match across elements one band), the current one filled, in the theme's colours; in a tooltip, inverted as its surface is.
